summary: This directory manages error handling mechanisms and associated testing logic for the application. It provides a dedicated location for defining how system errors are caught, processed, and validated to ensure robust runtime behavior.
responsibilities: Validating error resolution logic through automated tests
Standardizing the response to runtime exceptions
relationships: The error handling logic is verified through specialized test suites to ensure consistent behavior.
Test files within this directory use defined error patterns to simulate and validate system responses.
designDecisions: Colocation of error handling logic with its corresponding test definitions
Modular structure for isolated error verification
